name: New Ultimate Heroine Faerie Maya
original_name: ニューアルティメットヒロイン フェアリーマヤ
source:
When invaders from an alternate dimension threaten her homeworld,
when science fails to thwart pending doom and the future seems all but lost,
one heroic savior in her sexy tight outfit wields a beam of protection.
Is she strong enough to save the world?
